# Lectern

Lectern mirrors the Qt6 Lectern markdown viewer, pairing near-black and near-white chrome with a muted rainbow heading palette. Headings carry distinct colors, namely blue H1, purple H2, gold H3, green H4, terracotta H5 and gray H6, and dedicated background shades are set for code blocks.

![Lectern screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papaya2k/obsidian-lectern-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Lectern"
    author: "Papaya"
    repo:   "papaya2k/obsidian-lectern-theme"
    slug:   "lectern"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/lectern"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/papaya2k/obsidian-lectern-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/papaya2k/obsidian-lectern-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a Lectern-inspired light/dark appearance that mirrors the Qt6 markdown viewer, with near-black/white chrome and a muted rainbow heading palette. Use subtle heading colors (blue H1, purple H2, gold H3, green H4, terracotta H5, gray H6) and dedicated code background shades for clear, readable code blocks."
}
```
